description.value: A 30-acre forested private campground beside Swift Creek on Yellowhead Highway 5 at the edge of Valemount, where Chinook salmon spawn in summer; town centre, restaurants, and shops are a short walk away.

address.value: 325 North Highway #5, P.O. Box 387, Valemount, B.C., V0E 2Z0
